name: Renard Thaïs
source:
AGE: 26
HEIGHT: 175cm
BORN: September 26
WEIGHT: 77kg
NATIONALITY: French & Arab

[i]Societies grow when individuals cede personal rights in exchange for shared responsibility. These responsibilities become law. And these laws are enforced without exception.[/i]

Renard Thaïs is the World☆Class Prosecutor, a man serious to a fault who marries unparalleled shrewdness with precise attention to detail. Highly regarded for bringing some of the most callous and evasive criminals to justice, he’s equally famed for his words which are coarse and blunt like the rules-as-written laws he enforces. Those who know Renard best recognize that his hardliner ways stem from a deep sense of responsibility and a true desire to make the world a better place, particularly with regard to his younger brother Leandre.

Likes: Reading, caffeine, challenges, expanding his vocabulary, being right
Dislikes: Inanity, abuse of power, physical touch, leaving his brother alone
